_comment: Single source for every outbound link and the price string. Nothing else in the repo may hardcode these — scripts/build-workflows.mjs injects them, and scripts/validate.mjs fails the build if a hardcoded Apify URL or price appears anywhere else.
_affiliate: Empty on purpose — the owner has not registered for the Apify Affiliate Program yet. When they do, put the exact parameter their dashboard gives here and rebuild.
_price: Pricing is pay-per-event: $0.002 per extracted PDF (from $2.00 per 1k), failed/empty PDFs free, plus $0.005 per recovered OCR page.
